headline: Move purchase reviews forward without surrendering control
capabilities: Analyze approved vendors and contract terms in seconds
Identify best-value supplier and apply volume discounts
Automatically create and route purchase orders while flagging duplicate software licenses
outcomes: Reduced procurement cycle time from hours to minutes
Captured volume discounts and flagged duplicate spending
Delivered equipment on time while maintaining budget compliance
Freed team capacity for strategic vendor negotiations
why_try: The demo lets a procurement manager ask a natural question and receive a source-backed, reviewable answer with the approval boundary visible in the response.

sample_prompts.label: Procurement Manager: Purchase-request review
sample_prompts.prompt: Walk me through the cloud-upgrade request and tell me whose review it needs before anything moves.

sample_prompts.label: Category Buyer: Vendor evidence comparison
sample_prompts.prompt: Give me a neutral comparison of the approved cloud vendors; do not pick a winner.

sample_prompts.label: Department Approver: Approval-path recommendation
sample_prompts.prompt: This infrastructure request landed in my queue. What is the recommended approval path?

sample_prompts.label: Finance Director: Spend and budget review
sample_prompts.prompt: Where is the purchasing budget under pressure, and what should we review before approving more spend?
